page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.8xlarge is a storage and memory-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per core, and is bundled with 7679 GB of local SSD storage. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing performance is positioned in the lower tier, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core execution is more robust, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores consistently aligning with the middle 50% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the overall PassMark memory score remains in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of this instance type is the compromise between massive local storage capacity and modest single-thread CPU speed. While it is less suited for single-threaded processing or high-frequency compute tasks, the combination of 256.0 GB of RAM and nearly 7.7 TB of local SSD storage offers qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive workloads. It is structurally aligned for database hosting, Redis caching layers, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks that require large local scratch space.
